part1Questions.text: Do you live in a house or an apartment?
What is your favorite room in your home and why?
How long have you lived in your current home?
Do you work or are you a student?
Why did you choose that job or field of study?
What do you find most interesting about your work or studies?
What do you like most about living in your hometown?
Has your hometown changed much since you were a child?
Do you spend more time with your family or your friends?
What activities do you enjoy doing with your friends?
What do you usually do in your free time?
Is there a new hobby or sport you would like to try in the future?
How often do you use the internet for your work or daily routine?
What electronic device could you not live without?
What kind of food do you prefer to eat when you go out?
Do you enjoy traveling to new countries or cities?
What type of weather do you enjoy the most?
Do you prefer shopping online or visiting physical stores?

part3Questions.text: How has modern technology influenced the way people communicate in daily life?
Do you believe artificial intelligence will replace human jobs in the near future?
What are the ethical concerns surrounding automated decision making in healthcare and education?
In what ways are traditional teaching methods changing with digital educational tools?
Should higher education be free for all citizens in a modern society?
What measures should governments take to reduce urban environmental pollution?
How can individuals balance personal convenience with sustainable living habits?
How does tourism impact local cultures and heritage sites?
Is globalization causing traditional regional languages and customs to disappear?

quickPracticeQuestions.text: Describe your ideal vacation destination and explain why you would choose it.
How do you think remote work has changed employee productivity and work-life balance?
What is a book or film that made a deep impression on you recently, and why?
Do you think public transportation in cities should be expanded or replaced by private vehicles?
What personal skill would you like to master in the next five years, and how will you achieve it?

cueCards.topic: Describe a useful piece of technology that you use regularly.
bulletPoints: What it is
When you started using it
How you use it in your daily life
And explain why it is so useful to you
sampleFollowUpQuestions: How has this technology improved your productivity?
Do you think older generations find this technology easy to adopt?

cueCards.topic: Describe an artificial intelligence application or software program you find fascinating.
bulletPoints: What the application or program is
How you first learned about it
What tasks it performs
And explain why you find it fascinating
sampleFollowUpQuestions: How do you think AI will transform software development in the future?
What are the risks of relying too heavily on AI software?

cueCards.topic: Describe a person you know who is an inspiration to you.
bulletPoints: Who this person is
How long you have known them
What achievements or qualities they possess
And explain why they inspire you
sampleFollowUpQuestions: What qualities make a good role model for young people?
Are famous celebrities always good role models?

cueCards.topic: Describe a teacher who influenced your educational journey.
bulletPoints: Who the teacher was
What subject they taught you
How they taught and supported students
And explain how they influenced your learning
sampleFollowUpQuestions: What qualities define an effective educator?
How has the role of teachers changed with online education?

cueCards.topic: Describe a quiet place you like to visit when you want to relax.
bulletPoints: Where this place is
When you usually go there
What you do when you are there
And explain why it helps you relax
sampleFollowUpQuestions: Why is it becoming harder to find peaceful places in big cities?
Should city planners dedicate more space to parks and quiet green areas?

cueCards.topic: Describe a challenge you faced and successfully overcome.
bulletPoints: What the challenge was
When and where it occurred
How you addressed or solved it
And explain what you learned from this experience
sampleFollowUpQuestions: Why is overcoming setbacks important for personal development?
Do young people handle pressure better or worse than older adults?

cueCards.topic: Describe an item of value or sentiment that you own.
bulletPoints: What the item is
How you obtained or received it
How long you have kept it
And explain why it holds special meaning for you
sampleFollowUpQuestions: Why do people attach emotional value to physical possessions?
Do modern societies place too much importance on material possessions?

cueCards.topic: Describe a traditional festival or celebration in your country.
bulletPoints: What event or festival it is
When and how often it takes place
What activities people participate in
And explain why this event is significant in your culture
sampleFollowUpQuestions: Are traditional celebrations changing due to modern influence?
Why is it important to preserve cultural customs for future generations?

cueCards.topic: Describe a project or work task that you completed with a team.
bulletPoints: What the project or task was
Who was on your team
What role you played
And explain what contributed to the team success
sampleFollowUpQuestions: What skills are most critical for successful teamwork?
How can team leaders resolve internal conflicts effectively?

cueCards.topic: Describe a memorable trip or journey you took in the past.
bulletPoints: Where you went
Who traveled with you
What memorable activities you engaged in
And explain why this journey stands out in your memory
sampleFollowUpQuestions: How does traveling broaden a person’s worldview?
What are the advantages and drawbacks of solo travel?

cueCards.topic: Describe a special meal or traditional dish from your home region.
bulletPoints: What dish or meal it is
What ingredients are required to prepare it
When or on what occasions it is served
And explain why you enjoy this meal
sampleFollowUpQuestions: How have eating habits changed over the past few decades?
Is home cooking being replaced by fast food and delivery services?

cueCards.topic: Describe an outdoor activity or sport you enjoy participating in.
bulletPoints: What activity or sport it is
Where and when you practice it
Who you usually practice with
And explain how it benefits your health or wellbeing
sampleFollowUpQuestions: Why are outdoor recreation activities essential in modern urban lifestyles?
Should schools devote more time to physical education?

cueCards.topic: Describe an environmental rule or law in your country that you think is beneficial.
bulletPoints: What rule or regulation it is
How citizens are expected to comply with it
What problem it aims to solve
And explain why you believe it is beneficial
sampleFollowUpQuestions: How can governments encourage citizens to adopt eco-friendly habits?
Are international environmental agreements effective in combating climate change?
